rundown: Zips beat Minutemen 34-33 at Warren McGuirk Alumni Stadium in Amherst, MA. Zips came back: they were down 26-17 at the half. The 3rd quarter decided it: Zips won it 14-7. Their win chance dropped as low as 3% along the way.
Scoring: Zips 3 touchdowns and 2 field goals; Minutemen 4 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: A. Stire 28 yd FG GOOD (4th quarter, 5:34).

Leading the way — Zips: Cibastian Broughton 10/17, 165 yds, 1 TD, 2 INT; Jordan Gant 21 car, 151 yds, 2 TD; Miles Burris 3 rec, 59 yds, 1 TD. Minutemen: Logan Inagawa 12/21, 104 yds, 3 TD, 1 INT; Elijah Faulkner 13 car, 105 yds, 1 TD; Jabari Lewis 3 rec, 42 yds.
Where Zips won it: they outgained them 379 yards to 373.

Against the closing line (DraftKings): Minutemen closed as 3-point favorites and lost outright to Zips; Zips won as the underdog at +130; the total closed at 46.5 and they combined for 67, over by 20.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 18, 6:56 PM ET. It had Zips 41% and Minutemen 59%, projecting Zips 22.8 – Minutemen 26.2 (49 total, Minutemen by 3.4).

Final: Zips 34 – Minutemen 33. Wrong winner: it had Minutemen at 59%, and Zips (41%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Zips came in with a 26% below average attack and a 41% leakier than average defense (1-9, 18.6 scored and 33.2 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 23 and 173 games of evidence. Projected to score 22.8, they scored 34 (+11.2 points, 49% over); projected to allow 26.2, they allowed 33 (+6.8 points, 26% over).

Minutemen came in with a 28% below average attack and a 26% leakier than average defense (5-5, 24.3 scored and 22.3 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 186 and 182 games of evidence. Projected to score 26.2, they scored 33 (+6.8 points, 26% over); projected to allow 22.8, they allowed 34 (+11.2 points, 49% over).

The bigger miss was Zips' scoring (+11.2 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 67 against 49 projected (+18), about the 88th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Zips by 1 against Minutemen by 3.4 projected, about the 39th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
MASS ML (-166) at -166: the algo gave it 60% vs 60% fair (-0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 58%). AKR ML (+140) at +140: the algo gave it 40% vs 40% fair (+0.1 pts) — won (+1.4u); beat the close (closing fair chance 42%). MASS -3 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. AKR +3 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.1 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 46.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.6 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 46.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: Splits (Action Network): spread: 33% of bets on Zips, 36% of the money — Zips covered; total: 50% of bets on the over, 89% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 10% of bets on Zips, 12% of the money.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.284 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -5.7 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 134 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Minutemen attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
